connector.name: AEO Scanner
connector.registryDescription: AI visibility for ChatGPT/Perplexity/Claude - triple score (AEO+GEO+Agent) with fix code. Free.
connector.summary: Hosted at aeo-mcp.convrgent.ai over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the Python package aeo-scanner. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the convrgent account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
